'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 European floods]]
**[[2024 Spanish floods]]
***[[Prime Minister of Spain]] [[Pedro Sánchez]] announces an additional €3.76 billion (US$4 billion) aid package to the [[Valencian Community]] which was affected by deadly [[flood]]s in October. [https://www.dw.com/en/spain-pm-sanchez-announces-376-billion-in-flood-aid/a-70758227 (DW)]
* A [[mud volcano]] erupts in [[Turbo, Colombia]], forcing the preventative evacuation of 109 households. [https://www.elespectador.com/ambiente/se-registra-erupcion-de-volcan-san-jose-mulatos-en-antioquia-esto-se-sabe/ (El Espectador)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2024 United Nations Climate Change Conference]]
**The COP29 [[United Nations Climate Change Conference|climate conference]] opens in [[Baku]], [[Azerbaijan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/cop29-leaders-speak-summit-formally-opens-2024-11-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Zhuhai car attack]]
**Thirty-five people are killed and 43 more injured during a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] outside a stadium in [[Zhuhai]], [[Guangdong]], [[China]]. The perpetrator is in a [[coma]] after suffering serious injuries. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy1k2rx724o.amp (BBC News)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**Several airlines suspend flights to [[Haiti]] after a flight attendant was injured when a [[Spirit Airlines]] aircraft was hit by gunfire while attempting to land at [[Toussaint Louverture International Airport]] in [[Port-au-Prince]], Haiti, and was diverted to [[Santiago de los Caballeros]], [[Dominican Republic]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy9jpnl3j5wo (BBC News)]
*The [[International Criminal Court]] announces an investigation into [[Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court|prosecutor]] [[Karim Ahmad Khan]] over accusations of [[sexual misconduct]] previously reported by ''[[The Guardian]]'' in October. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0j8dq235e2o (BBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/law/2024/nov/11/icc-prosecutor-to-face-external-investigation-into-sexual-misconduct-claims (''The Guardian'')]
*In [[Italy]], the [[Carabinieri Art Squad]] seizes more than 2,100 [[art forgery|forged artworks]] worth more than €200 million (US$215 million) that were intended to be sold at [[auction house]]s across [[Europe]] and also uncovers two art forgery workshops in [[Tuscany]] and [[Venice]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/italy-police-bust-crime-network-forging-renowned-paintings/a-70758728 (DW)]
*One of the friars who was assaulted in a monastery in [[Gilet]], [[Province of Valencia]], Spain two days prior, dies after failing to recover from serious injuries. [https://www.rtve.es/noticias/20241111/fallece-monje-agredido-monasterio-gilet-hombre-autoproclamo-jesucristo/16326029.shtml (RTVE)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Japanese general election]]
**[[Shigeru Ishiba]] is sworn in as the 103rd [[prime minister of Japan]] following the first runoff vote in thirty years. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2024/11/58a9cd9d684b-ishiba-poised-to-be-reelected-as-japan-pm-eyes-minority-govt.html (''Kyodo News'')] [https://mainichi.jp/articles/20241111/k00/00m/010/129000c (''Mainichi'')]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**[[Alix Didier Fils-Aimé]] is appointed as the new [[Prime Minister of Haiti]], replacing [[Garry Conille]], amid worsening security in the country.  [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/haitian-transitional-presidential-council-appoints-new-prime-minister-2024-11-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Māori protest movement]]
**Hundreds of [[Māori people]] begin a nine-day [[Hīkoi|march]] from [[Cape Reinga]] to [[Wellington]], the capital city of [[New Zealand]], to protest the proposed [[Treaty Principles Bill]] which would redefine the [[principles of the Treaty of Waitangi|principles]] of the [[Treaty of Waitangi]]. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2024/11/11/new-zealand-maori-begin-march-on-capital-to-protest-indigenous-treaty-bill (''The Star'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/nov/07/treaty-of-waitangi-new-zealand-founding-document-changes-bill (''The Guardian'')]
